newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber trade quiet ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber trade quiet ahead of weekend.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was quiet by midsession on Friday as the trade marked time ahead of the weekend while looking for leads in the afternoon session, dealers said.
Bridgestone, which was said to have bought several hundred tonnes of TSR20 rubber over the past three days, was not seen in the market, they said.
"It's the end of the week and the whole thing has slowed down a bit. I did not hear of any trades this morning, but we'll see how it goes this afternoon," a dealer said.
"The market is also waiting to see what the Japanese market is like this afternoon although the levels there are not very encouraging," another dealer said.
The looming summer holiday season in the major rubber consuming countries added to the gloom in the local market.
At 0445 GMT, August RSS3 was indicated at 107.00-109.00 U.S. cents a kg from 109.25 cents.

August RSS1 was indicated at 153.75 Singapore cents (US$1.08) a kg from 155.75 cents. August TSR20 was indicated at 143.50-145.50 Singapore cents (US$1.01-$1.02) a kg from 145.50 cents. - (S$1.42 = US$1) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
